title: Checkpoint
description: What the operator publishes for one tick of a schedule fixed in advance, whether or not the log moved: a short, fixed-size, signed commitment to the log's history and nothing else, no size, no root, no count and no salt (REQ-AUD-14, ADR-0005). Its signature is the log's own key's, over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the checkpoint without signature.value. What it commits to, and the salt, are its opening (urn:rutent:core-internal:checkpoint-opening), never published.

at.description: When the tick fell on the schedule, to the second: the schedule's time, never the time of writing.

commitment.description: SHA-256 over a domain, the log, the tick, a fresh salt, the log's size and its root, as CMP-CORE-AUDIT's checkpointer computes it: only an opening's holder can open it.

tick.description: The tick on the schedule, as 16 lower-case hexadecimal digits, so a checkpoint's size never tells how far along the schedule it is.

key.description: The log's own key, never the operator's statement key.

value.description: The 64-byte signature, base64url without padding, in its one canonical encoding.
